items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I had another set of drums over at the nightclub on State Street where Glover Compton had the band and I was playing drums at Glover

ctx.x: Jimmy Blight had the band and reason I said he was a good ranger he had a small band and he was writing the music for the band and arranging this in small for a small combination to play this type of stuff that we was playing had to play with the pitches and I was playing drums with them in the orchestra at this theater that was Jimmy O'Brien was playing clarinet and I think Clarence Black was playing violin no no a fellow from St. Louis was playing violin named Pic Young because Pic did some recording with us on…
that's a lot more information I never heard about about Jimmy Pike
